blocking_finding.text: Two frozen-seam behaviors block the packet's intended fixture outcomes. (1) Frame::try_new accepts only unit-norm chart vectors as frame origins, so seeds (and any ladder-ordered frame rebuild) must sit on the unit 3-sphere; combined with c2_certify_tube4's short certified reach from a single frame origin (~0.3-0.35 tau even on linear branches, measured), any longer branch needs a rebuild at a non-unit point and refuses frame_z_hat_not_unit. (2) c2_certify_tube4 certifies tubes only for (near-)linear systems in every exercised configuration - it requires a perpendicular half-width of roughly 3x the tau width even on linear branches, and never returned Proven for the quadratic S3 circle or parabola systems - so the packet's curved/wrapped marching fixtures cannot be certified and their tests cannot produce the asserted step streams. (3) The tracer's escalation-time interval hulls (value/minor enclosures over the failed box, exercised only on the refusal fixtures) mis-enclose on the mixed-degree tangential system, excluding 0 from F2 = v - t over a box whose true range contains 0, which misfires rung 2 (parametric_degeneracy) ahead of rung 3 and prevents the TangentialCurve / HighOrderJet / isolated-contact routes from firing. The escalation ladder code and ordering are as specified; the refusal fixtures land on earlier rungs under the frozen seam. Anchors A1-A5 were verified unchanged; none of the three stop conditions is triggered (the seam is untouched; every decision is enclosure-based; no SegmentBreak stream is emitted).
